FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Start Laundry Services
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Clean St, Suite 100, Laundry Town, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh Start Laundry Services provides full-service laundry solutions, operating in a clean, well-maintained facility. We offer wash and fold services, dry cleaning, and a linen supply service specifically designed for hotels, restaurants, and healthcare facilities. Our operations utilize modern, environmentally-compliant equipment to minimize chemical risks while ensuring high-quality cleaning. To ensure safety and customer satisfaction, our laundromat features on-site staff during all operating hours, providing assistance and improving oversight. Additionally, all operations adhere to local, state, and federal environmental regulations, prioritizing both compliance and sustainability in our service delivery.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On May 10, 2022, a water pipe in the laundry facility burst, causing water damage to the washing machines and the flooring. The estimated repair costs were $1,500. The claim has been settled, and repairs were completed by June 15, 2022. On March 5, 2023, equipment malfunction led to operational downtime, resulting in a revenue loss of approximately $1,000. There were no claims filed for this incident as it was considered a business interruption rather than a physical loss.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, UL rated, 3-hour fire resistant, with electronic locking mechanism.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel and perimeter fencing to enhance safety and deter vandalism.
